shortDescription: Resource module for Wireless Settings Ap Profiles

options.name: apPowerProfileName
options.description: Name of the existing AP power profile.

options.name: apProfileName
options.description: Name of the Access Point profile. Max length is 32 characters.

options.name: awipsEnabled
options.description: Indicates if AWIPS is enabled on the AP.

options.name: awipsForensicEnabled
options.description: Indicates if AWIPS forensic is enabled on the AP. Forensic Capture is supported from IOS-XE version 17.4 and above. Forensic Capture can be activated only if aWIPS is enabled.

options.name: calendarPowerProfiles
options.description: Wireless Settings Ap Profiles's calendarPowerProfiles.

options.name: clientLimit
options.description: Number of clients. Value should be between 0-1200.

options.name: countryCode
options.description: Country Code.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the AP profile. Max length is 241 characters.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_host
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center hostname.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_port
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center port.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. AP Profile ID.

options.name: managementSetting
options.description: Wireless Settings Ap Profiles's managementSetting.

options.name: meshEnabled
options.description: This indicates whether mesh networking is enabled on the AP. For IOS-XE devices, when mesh networking is enabled, a custom mesh profile with the configured parameters will be created and mapped to the AP join profile on the device. When mesh networking is disabled, any existing custom mesh profile will be deleted from the device, and the AP join profile will be mapped to the default mesh profile on the device.

options.name: meshSetting
options.description: Wireless Settings Ap Profiles's meshSetting.

options.name: pmfDenialEnabled
options.description: Indicates if PMF denial is active on the AP. PMF Denial is supported from IOS-XE version 17.12 and above.

options.name: remoteWorkerEnabled
options.description: Indicates if remote worker mode is enabled on the AP. Remote teleworker enabled profile cannot support security features like aWIPS,Forensic Capture Enablement, Rogue Detection and Rogue Containment.

options.name: rogueDetectionSetting
options.description: Wireless Settings Ap Profiles's rogueDetectionSetting.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: In the Time Zone area, choose one of the following options. Not Configured - APs operate in the UTC time zone. Controller - APs operate in the Cisco Wireless Controller time zone. Delta from Controller - APs operate in the offset time from the wireless controller time zone.

options.name: timeZoneOffsetHour
options.description: Enter the hour value (HH). The valid range is from -12 through 14.

options.name: timeZoneOffsetMinutes
options.description: Enter the minute value (MM). The valid range is from 0 through 59.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
